gameMoreless.title: Which One
gameMoreless.intro: Compare the influence scores of two historical figures. Pick the higher one. Keep going until you get it wrong. How long can your streak last?
gameMoreless.mobileRule: Tap the figure with the higher influence score. Keep your streak alive!
gameMoreless.fixtureNotice: Running in demo mode with sample data. The live version uses a pool of 1,500+ figures.
gameMoreless.question: Who has the higher influence score?
gameMoreless.hint: Influence score combines 7 axes: political, strategic, technological, social, economic, cultural, and transhistorical impact

rules.compareBody: Two figures appear side by side. Pick the one with the higher influence score.
rules.streakBody: Get it right and the next pair appears instantly. One wrong answer ends the game.
rules.recordBody: Your streak is your score. Challenge yourself to go further each time.
